subject: Re: Kickoff: honest privacy accounting for our DP-SGD pipelines
body:
Ximena,

Staffing: Yara owns the accounting math and the shuffling-vs-Poisson comparison surfaces; Farah integrates against the dp_accounting interfaces; Leilani builds the pipeline audit tooling; Amara supports the empirical validation runs (she's fractional here — heads-down on another data-platforms project most of this half).

Compute: the accountants themselves are numpy/scipy on CPU — negligible. The empirical validation is the ask: to show the reported bounds are tight in practice we rerun two production-scale DP training jobs under each of the three samplers (shuffle, Poisson, balls-and-bins). For that we hold the cirrus-tpu reservation for the week of 2026-06-01 — 128 accelerators from the trust-theory portfolio allocation, confirmed with the Infra side. One week covers both jobs times three samplers.

Audit tooling design review is April 3 if you want to sit in.

Jelena
